statement: For each A0-supported width, the domain-parametric A0 addition definition agrees with the declared modular result and Z/N/C/V condition predicates for every operand pair.
scope: Eight separate fixed-width QF_BV theorems at widths 8, 16, 24, 32, 40, 48, 56, and 64; pure register addition without memory or trap behavior.
exclusions: An induction theorem over arbitrary word widths
Subtraction, shifts, multiplication, memory, traps, and instruction decoding
Kernel reconstruction of the bit-vector theorem

negative_control.mutates: Invert the symbolic carry predicate; require SAT, enumerate a width-8 model, and replay encoded A0 add

limitations: The symbolic AdditionDomain adapter and Axeyum term-to-CNF lowering are trusted reductions.
LRAT checks each clausal refutation but does not reconstruct a theorem in the Lean kernel.
The satisfiable inverted-carry mutation is exhaustively model-searched and concretely replayed only at width 8.
Unit propagation reaches a no-conflict fixpoint with zero assignments for every saved CNF, so each refutation is load-bearing rather than an empty-clause wrapper around a propagation contradiction.
